Packaging release: every build now ships an installable Firefox add-on file.

## What changed

- Releases carry **`tetratype-<version>.xpi`** alongside the zip, built automatically by CI.
  `bun run build:xpi` produces both locally.
- Optional **Mozilla signing for self-distribution** on the `unlisted` channel, so a signed
  build can be produced without listing the add-on on addons.mozilla.org. It runs only when
  the `AMO_API_KEY` and `AMO_API_SECRET` repository secrets are set, and is skipped silently
  otherwise.

## Which file do I want?

| File | Use it when |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `tetratype-<version>.zip` | Unpack it and load `manifest.json` through `about:debugging`. Always works; gone on restart. |
| `tetratype-<version>.xpi` | Unsigned. Installs in builds that do not enforce signatures, after setting `xpinstall.signatures.required` to `false`. Release Firefox will refuse it. |
| `tetratype-<version>-signed.xpi` | Present only when the repository has AMO credentials. Installs in ordinary Firefox and survives restarts. |

No functional changes to capture or analysis — v0.2.0's behaviour is unchanged.
